thig3.8:1.1: yaṃ taṃ isīhi pattabbaṃ ṭhānaṃ durabhisaṃbhavaṃ | na taṃ dvaṅgulipaññāya sakkā pappotum itthiyā. || ||
thig3.8:2.1: itthibhāvo no kiṃ kayirā cittamhi susamāhite | ñāṇamhi vattamānamhi sammā dhammaṃ vipassato. || ||
thig3.8:3.1: sabbattha vihatā nandi tamokkhandho padālito | evaṃ jānāhi pāpima nihato tvam asi antaka. || || Somā. ||
